objective: Stand up the Exodia tool-bearing Rig: a new omp_toolbelt transcribe variant whose OMP agent drives host-authored geometry tools (detector evidence, column crops, deterministic count verification) to produce one finished transcription, evaluated paired against the pure-policy omp_extension baseline on the visible Borg.cin.361 f004r case.
hypothesis: Host-staged detector evidence plus a deterministic verify_counts tool lets the same model produce a finished transcription with lower character error than the evidence-free full-image baseline, without violating any suite hard limit.

rig.concept: Exodia Rig = immutable model reference + immutable harness. Here the harness is the omp_toolbelt station: task, skill prompt, host extension with read/verify_counts/submit_transcription grants, and pinned detector evidence staging. The candidate extension is an empty no-op policy on both sides, so the paired delta measures the host harness alone.

detector.settings: production align pins: tile 512, overlap 96, threshold 0.31, nms 0.4, rfdetr 1.8.3, torch 2.7.0+cu118
detector.torchvision_note: pinned 0.22.0+cu118 to match installed runtime metadata; the recipe writes the abbreviated 0.22.0

staged_evidence: evidence/geometry.json with right-to-left column map and per-column counts
toolbelt_harness.tools: read (images/ and evidence/ only), verify_counts (deterministic count comparison), submit_transcription (single use)
toolbelt_harness.partition_compliance: Tool-bearing Rigs are evaluated on R_train cases per the Exodia partition; vatican_borg_cin_361 f004r is the visible R_train transcription case.

evaluation.verified: bench verify passed: cases=1 objects=35 candidates=37 judges=1 reports=47
evaluation.executor: inline development execution; subprocess isolation reserved for any decisive rerun

gates.finished_output: the challenger session ends with exactly one accepted submit_transcription artifact
gates.quality: challenger character_error_rate at or below the baseline's on the shared case
gates.hard_limits: all four suite hard limits pass on the challenger
gates.budget_stop: bench run --max-cost aborts further dispatch at the ceiling

budget.paid_gpu: none; RF-DETR runs on the local workstation GPU

allowed_changes: library/evaluations (run records produced by bench run)
non_goals: Do not modify the exodia campaign loop, partition, or archive.
Do not run bench propose or promote.
Do not touch sealed evaluation families.
next_permitted_action: Run the paired evaluation under the declared budget, inspect the finished transcription and report, then record the result.
